I added a page to your Reading log note. It has:

- **Cover-style cards:** each book is a colored cover with its title and author. The star rating and finish date sit underneath, newest first.
- **Average rating:** shown at the top next to your total books and the number finished in 2026.
- **Books per month:** a bar chart covering the last 12 months.
- **Log a book:** a small form at the bottom that adds a new row to your table.

I haven't opened the page myself, so I haven't seen how it looks. Your table and note text are unchanged. You can switch between Page and Text in the app.
